text:
nora: Drafted the relnotes for the routing + batching updates and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/782. Main asks: quick snippet sanity check, add deprecation note for the legacy cache, and a tiny known-issues blurb for autoscale fallbacks.

devin: Taking a look. First pass: the dependency paragraph still mentions `redis-prefix-cache`  we removed that in Dedicated v0.9. Recommend a short deprecation banner pointing to `unified-kv-cache` + migration guide.

kai: Snippet check: both Python and JS samples call `model: 'kestrel'`. Runtime mapping expects `kestrel-v2` now, so we'll get 404s. I'll push a tiny patch to update examples and add a snippet rendering test.

frank: Support asked for a one-line fallback note in the routing table. Suggested wording: "During autoscale warm-up requests may be routed to compatible smaller variants; pin `model_variant` on Dedicated routes to avoid this." Add INF-3124 link in Known issues.

nora: Plan: (1) add deprecation banner for `redis-prefix-cache` with migration link, (2) update snippets to `kestrel-v2`, (3) paste frank's fallback one-liner under Known issues with INF-3124, (4) run linkcheck.

docs-bot: PR #782 updated by nora  changed files: docs/relnotes/2024-08-routing-batching.md, snippets/python/kestrel_example.md. CI: linkcheck queued.

devin: Running local linkcheck: `./tools/linkcheck docs/relnotes --output=artifacts/links-relnotes.json`. Results: 3 broken anchors and one external redirect. I'll open a small PR for anchor fixes and suggested redirect notes so older links don't break.

kai: PR #783 opened to swap `kestrel` -> `kestrel-v2` in PY/JS snippets and to standardize on `model=` param. Includes a basic snippet render unit test.

frank: Draft pasteable Known-issue block (use as-is):

Known issue: autoscale routing fallback
- Symptom: brief routing to fallback variants during cold starts under heavy concurrency
- Mitigation: pin `model_variant` or increase warm-pool size for Dedicated routes
- Tracking: INF-3124

nora: Adding that verbatim and the deprecation callout for the legacy cache. Devin, please include the list of broken anchors in the PR description so I can file redirects if needed.

devin: PR #784 opened with anchor fixes and redirect suggestions. CI had one flaky renderer test; re-run queued.

docs-bot: PR #783 merged by kai  snippets updated. PR #784 merged by devin  anchors fixed and linkcheck green on staging.

nora: Final pre-publish checklist:
- [x] Deprecation callout for `redis-prefix-cache` added with migration link
- [x] Snippets updated to `kestrel-v2` (PY/JS)
- [x] Known-issue blurb added (INF-3124)
- [x] Linkcheck passing on staging
- [ ] JP localization: kai to open i18n stub

kai: I'll add `/i18n/jp/relnotes/2024-08-routing.md` as a stub once the anchors are stable. If localization misses the publish window we ship EN and follow with a localized patch.

nora: Shipping plan: publish EN relnotes at 18:00 UTC if JP isn't merged; otherwise include translations. I'll post announcement copy here for a quick review before sending. Thanks all. :rocket:
